No per-tier/index/skala_usaha selector exists in cure_canonical_collisions.py today (Lot 8 PENDING-ARMS §3.4/§5.1b, this is the second confirmed instance of that exact gap) — a whole-array detach would destroy 93191's one genuinely-sound tier, so per_skala is held completely untouched pending that primitive. Separately, canonical's status_mapping=MATCH_LANGSUNG mislabels a genuine 2-parent crosswalk merge: 93191(2025) is a merge of 93191(2020) + 82302 ('Jasa Penyelenggara Event Khusus', special-event-organizer services) — corrected to MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE (gate report §3.4, Kimi red-team F1), matching the program's established multi-parent-merge convention (PENDING-ARMS line 344 precedent + same-table siblings 93210/93291/93294/93299, which already carry MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE). 82302 is recorded here as provenance only, never injected into pp28_sources (rule #9 — no new source values authored by this compiler).
